# Splice

> > Splice is a mobile video editing app for iOS and Android that empowers creators with professional features like speed ramp, chroma key, multitrack editing, and automatic subtitles for social media content.

Splice provides intuitive video editing tools designed for content creators, influencers, and social media enthusiasts who want to produce high-quality videos for platforms like TikTok and Instagram. Available on both App Store and Google Play, Splice combines powerful editing capabilities with mobile-first simplicity.

## Key Topics
